redact_secrets: redact known secret and credential patterns from an arbitrary string containing API keys, tokens, or passwords
create_SecretRedactionFilter: create a logging filter that scrubs known secret and credential patterns from log records before they are written
create_JsonFormatter: create a JSON formatter that converts log records to structured JSON with parsed embedded dicts and extra fields
create_uvicorn_json_log_config: create a uvicorn log config dictionary that applies JSON formatting to all uvicorn access and error logs
run_turn_on_json: run the setup to enable JSON logging across all LiteLLM loggers with secret redaction
